payload.description_html:
The larger track represents Caririchnium leonardii, which was made by an iguanodontid (ornithopod) dinosaur.  The slender track represents Magnoavipes, which was made by a theropod or ornithopod dinosaur.
Locality: eastern side of Dinosaur Ridge, between Interstate 70 and the town of Morrison, west of Denver, north-central Colorado, USA
